statement: Under Shin's label-level definition nu(h,4)=min{D>=0: R_D(h,4)=R(h,4)} with four-subsets of the literal interval [0,D], the exact value is nu(4,4)=15. Equivalently, R_15(4,4)=R(4,4), and 15 is minimal. The exhaustive spectra R_15(4,4) and R_16(4,4) both equal {13,16,17,19,21,23,24,25,26,27,29,30,31,32,33,34,35}.
contribution: A complete exact finite resolution of the frozen (h,k)=(4,4) question. A coefficient-vector enumeration covers all 1820 four-subsets of [0,15] and all 2380 four-subsets of [0,16], validates witnesses for every label, and independently agrees with the earlier tuple enumeration. Combined with both directions of Shin's Corollary 10.5, equality of the two finite spectra proves the claimed minimum. This does not settle the all-h question and makes no priority claim.
